title: Four letters
description: Altruvex is a small studio in Cairo building multilingual web systems. The name starts with altr-, as in altruism: when your interest and ours disagree, the decision follows yours.

stage.caption: Cairo. English and Arabic, neither translated.

principles.title: What that commits us to
principles.count: {count, plural, one {{n} principle} other {{n} principles}} · open any

direct.title: You talk to the person who builds it.
direct.body: No sales, no account manager, no subcontractor. The founder is on the first call and on the call at launch.
direct.cost: We take fewer projects than a studio with a sales team would.

scope.title: We argue you out of scope.
scope.body: If a page, a feature, or an entire phase will not earn back what it costs to build, we say so before it is quoted - not after it ships.
scope.cost: The recommendation that removes a feature removes a line from our own invoice.

pricing.title: The number does not move quietly.
pricing.body: Estimates are broken down before the contract, not defended after it. If scope changes, the change order arrives before the work starts - not with the final invoice.
pricing.cost: A number fixed in advance is a bet against our own estimate, and we pay when it is wrong.

ownership.title: It is yours at final payment.
ownership.body: Repositories, domains and pipelines in your name, documented for the engineer after us. Nothing is engineered to make leaving difficult.
ownership.cost: We keep no leverage over a client who decides to walk.

fit.title: Who this is for,
fitItems: A business that needs a system, not a brochure
Customers in both English and Arabic
Someone who wants to own the code outright
notItems: A theme with a new logo by Friday
A project with no one to make decisions
A rebuild meant to lock you in

founderRoute.eyebrow: Between your decision and the code
founderRoute.quote: The goal is not to appear premium. It is to build work others can copy the surface of,
founderRoute.quoteItalic: but not the standard behind it.
